reasoning_summary: Selected features prioritize stable, interpretable credit-risk signals with zero missingness and broad coverage. Core credit quality indicators like fico_mean, loan_to_income, dti, and revol_util lead due to their strong, durable predictive power and interpretability. Income capacity and leverage ratios (e.g., tot_hi_cred_lim_to_income, total_bal_ex_mort_to_income) provide essential exposure context. Account activity and history features (e.g., mo_sin_rcnt_tl, num_tl_op_past_12m, acc_open_past_24mths) add durable behavioral signals. Redundancy is controlled by preferring representative aggregates over near-duplicates unless variants add distinct information (e.g., bands and shares included only when they provide meaningful granularity). Features with potential leakage or unstable sparse tail behavior were excluded. The final list covers broad semantic groups including credit quality, indebtedness, utilization, capacity, delinquency proxies, and customer demographics, ensuring a stable and interpretable candidate pool for downstream selection.
